description: Submit a DataFrame of prompts to OpenAI's async Batch API (~50% cheaper than synchronous chat completions). One component bundles the whole lifecycle: a submit asset, a results asset, and an auto-wired status sensor (wait_for_completion=False, the default) -- or a single blocking asset that submits, polls, and returns parsed results inline (wait_for_completion=True). Content-addressed idempotency: retries/re-runs with unchanged prompts reattach to the existing batch instead of resubmitting.

outputs.description: Parsed results DataFrame (or a small submission manifest for the internal __submit asset when wait_for_completion=False)

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the results asset -- the one downstream assets should depend on. When wait_for_completion=False, a companion '{asset_name}__submit' asset and a '{asset_name}__batch_status_sensor' sensor are also created automatically; you never need to name or wire those yourself.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame of prompts.

prompt_column.label: Prompt Column
prompt_column.description: Column holding the raw text to send as the user message. Mutually exclusive with prompt_template.

prompt_template.label: Prompt Template
prompt_template.description: Format-string template using row values, e.g. "Summarize: {body}". Rendered per row via str.format(**row_dict). Mutually exclusive with prompt_column.

id_column.label: ID Column
id_column.description: Column to use as each row's custom_id in the batch request. If unset, the row's positional index (as a string) is used.

model.label: Model
model.description: OpenAI model id used in each batch request's body.

system_prompt.label: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: System message prepended to each request.

completion_window.label: Completion Window
completion_window.description: OpenAI batch completion window. Currently '24h' is the only value OpenAI accepts, but this stays a field for forward-compat.

output_schema.label: Output Schema
output_schema.description: Dotted path to a Pydantic model for typed output, e.g. 'my_project.schemas:SupportReply' (module.path:ClassName). Each row's raw_output is parsed as JSON and validated against this model; on success the model's fields are merged in as extra columns. On ANY failure (bad JSON, validation error) the row is marked invalid_output=True with raw_output kept as-is -- it never fails the asset.

wait_for_completion.label: Wait For Completion
wait_for_completion.description: If True, a single asset (named asset_name) submits, polls synchronously to a terminal state, and returns the fully parsed results DataFrame directly -- blocking, no sensor created. If False (default), submit/reattach returns immediately with a small manifest under '{asset_name}__submit', and the auto-created '{asset_name}__batch_status_sensor' materializes '{asset_name}' once OpenAI finishes the batch -- no worker blocks waiting.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between polls. Used when wait_for_completion=True (blocking) or by the status sensor's own live-status check.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for a terminal state before raising. Only used when wait_for_completion=True.

sensor_minimum_interval_seconds.label: Sensor Minimum Interval Seconds
sensor_minimum_interval_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between the auto-created status sensor's evaluations. Only used when wait_for_completion=False.

sensor_default_status.label: Sensor Default Status
sensor_default_status.description: 'running' or 'stopped' -- initial status of the auto-created sensor. Only used when wait_for_completion=False.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the OpenAI API key.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — list of team names or email addresses, e.g. ['team:analytics', 'user@company.com']

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the assets, e.g. {'domain': 'support', 'tier': 'gold'}

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog, e.g. ['openai', 'llm']. Defaults to ['openai', 'llm'] if not set.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
